_readme: OAuth client ids for the sign-in providers. These are PUBLIC values --
the GitHub device flow and Dropbox PKCE both exist so that a desktop app
needs no client secret -- but they are per-distribution, so a fork should
register its own rather than borrow these. See docs/providers.md for the
An empty id just means that provider says 'not configured' when picked;
the self-hosted server option needs no id at all and always works.
